title: Stargazer
description: [WIP]Minecraft mod about watching stars and visiting other planets
body: ![Mod name with work in progress text below](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e35716537df7903d097707980b174bb6d79b8f95.png) # Requirements # About mod This mod is one person project about watching stars and visiting diffrent planets # Hot to start Take Spyglass in the night and watch sky above you Craft Starforge ![Creafting recipe for starforge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c73f6f01986c3e1940d0bb2a0a89804712cce72_0.webp) And use that for crafting loadstar needded to open portal to other dimension ![Loadstar crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fdfea9cb96034ed5a4a1f8e482966d9be9c84dd_0.webp) After you craft load star build copper portal just like in the picture ![Copper Portal Structure](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/PhPdCBxE/images/e694f7263774e77976af8700a0d45cbd05a9889d.png) And use loadstar in the middle
